resources.string: Detects when you go from Messenger to Facebook and immediately takes you back to your chats. The app has no internet access and sends nothing anywhere.
Facebook blocked, back to your chats
Opening Facebook from Messenger is blocked.
Turn on the DoomStop service in Accessibility settings.
Also kicks you out of the Facebook app when you open it directly, not only from Messenger.
Dumps Messenger screen labels to logcat. Includes chat content, so turn it off after calibration.

When you tap the Facebook icon in Messenger, or facebook.com opens in the Messenger browser, DoomStop closes it and you are back in your chats. The app has no internet access and sends nothing anywhere.
